http_request_cache_settings.description: Blog: cache public static documents from GitHub Pages
http_request_cache_settings.expression: (http.host eq "wangyufeng.org" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.cookie eq "" and not any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cdn-cgi/") and http.request.uri.path ne "/land-below-the-wind/" and not http.request.uri.query contains "lang=" and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".html") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".json") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".txt") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".xml")))

http_request_cache_settings.description: Blog: bypass cookies, authorization, API and language negotiation
http_request_cache_settings.expression: (http.host eq "wangyufeng.org" and (http.cookie ne "" or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cdn-cgi/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/land-below-the-wind/" or http.request.uri.query contains "lang="))

http_response_headers_transform.description: Blog: browser security baseline; preserve map and camera features

content-security-policy-report-only.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' https://static.cloudflareinsights.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; connect-src 'self' https://server.arcgisonline.com https://cloudflareinsights.com https://*.cloudflareinsights.com; font-src 'self' data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; frame-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self'
